$comment: The base bundle — the source language. §E10.1: every string in the product resolves through src/lib/i18n/strings.ts, and the Phase 5 locale registry overrides these by key. A locale added in the control plane appears in the UI with no code change because these keys already exist. Nothing here is a colour, a number, or a format; those are tokens.
severity.label: Severity
status.pending_classification: Parked for a person to look at
status.pending_classification.detail: The classifier was unavailable, so this report is waiting for a person rather than being guessed at.
status.flagged.detail: Routed out of the normal path by trust and safety. Nothing has been decided.
flag.systemFlagged: Flagged by the system — not a finding
suppression.withheld.one: Fewer than {threshold} report — withheld to protect reporters
suppression.withheld.other: Fewer than {threshold} reports — withheld to protect reporters
suppression.why: Small counts can identify the person who filed them.
degraded.title: Running in a reduced mode
receipt.title: Your report has been recorded
receipt.appendOnly: This record cannot be edited. Corrections are added, never overwritten.
evidence.title: What has happened
evidence.empty: Nothing has happened yet. The first entry appears the moment it does.
beforeAfter.ssimAmbiguous: Image similarity {score} — too close to call either way
beforeAfter.handle: Drag to compare before and after
ledger.noSingleScore: These four are reported separately on purpose. There is no overall score, because an average would hide the one that matters.
notWired.label: Not wired
notWired.detail: This screen is built against the real contract. The phase that fills it in has not landed, so it is showing nulls.
event.exif_check_completed: Photo checked — taken here, taken now
event.pipeline_stage_degraded: A stage took its fallback path
event.system_degradation: The system is running in a reduced mode
event.safety_trigger_fired: Safety override — moved ahead of the queue
